name: Swarm of Rats
classification: Medium Swarm of Tiny Beasts, unaligned
otherStatistics: Initiative +0 (10). Proficiency Bonus +2. Senses Darkvision 30 ft., Passive Perception 10. Languages none. Resistances Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing. Condition immunities Charmed, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Prone, Restrained, Stunned.
appearance: A tight heap of brown and gray rats with rounded ears, whiskers, and tangled bare tails.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Monster Manual with the 2024 rules, p. 370. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/5195228-swarm-of-rats
sections.Traits: Swarm. The swarm and other creatures can share spaces. It can move through openings that admit a Tiny rat. It cannot regain Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points.
sections.Actions: Bites. Make a +2 melee attack within 5 ft. A hit deals 5 (2d4) piercing damage, or 2 (1d4) piercing damage while the swarm is Bloodied.

name: Swarm of Ravens
classification: Medium Swarm of Tiny Beasts, unaligned
otherStatistics: Initiative +2 (12). Proficiency Bonus +2. Senses Passive Perception 15. Languages none. Resistances Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing. Condition immunities Charmed, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Prone, Restrained, Stunned.
appearance: A flock of dark ravens with black bills and broad wings spread at different angles.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Monster Manual with the 2024 rules, p. 371. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/5195229-swarm-of-ravens
sections.Traits: Swarm. The swarm and other creatures can share spaces. It can move through openings that admit a Tiny raven. It cannot regain Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points.
sections.Actions:
Beaks. Make a +4 melee attack within 5 ft. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 2 (1d4) piercing damage while the swarm is Bloodied.
Cacophony (Recharge 6). Choose one creature in the swarm’s space. It makes a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure it is Deafened until the start of the swarm’s next turn and has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls while Deafened by this action.

name: Swarm of Venomous Snakes
classification: Medium Swarm of Tiny Beasts, unaligned
otherStatistics: Initiative +4 (14). Proficiency Bonus +2. Senses Blindsight 10 ft., Passive Perception 10. Languages none. Resistances Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing. Condition immunities Charmed, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Prone, Restrained, Stunned.
appearance: A tangle of brown and olive snakes with patterned scales, raised heads, and forked tongues.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Monster Manual with the 2024 rules, p. 371. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/5195231-swarm-of-venomous-snakes
sections.Traits: Swarm. The swarm and other creatures can share spaces. It can move through openings that admit a Tiny snake. It cannot regain Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points.
sections.Actions: Bites. Make a +6 melee attack within 5 ft. A hit deals 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage, or 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage while the swarm is Bloodied. A hit also deals 10 (3d6) poison damage in either case.

name: Tiger
otherStatistics: Initiative +3 (13). Proficiency Bonus +2. Senses Darkvision 60 ft., Passive Perception 13. Languages none.
appearance: An orange tiger with black stripes, a pale muzzle, heavy paws, and a long ringed tail.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Monster Manual with the 2024 rules, p. 371. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/4775846-tiger
sections.Actions: Rend. Make a +5 melee attack within 5 ft. A hit deals 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage. A Large or smaller creature hit also falls Prone.
sections.Bonus actions: Nimble Escape. Use Disengage or Hide as a Bonus Action.

name: Triceratops
otherStatistics: Initiative -1 (9). Proficiency Bonus +3. Senses Passive Perception 10. Languages none.
appearance: A low, heavy dinosaur with a bony neck frill, two long brow horns, and a shorter nose horn.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Monster Manual with the 2024 rules, p. 372. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/5195238-triceratops
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Gore attacks.
Gore. Make a +9 melee attack within 5 ft. A hit deals 19 (2d12 + 6) piercing damage. If the target is Huge or smaller and the triceratops moved at least 20 ft. straight toward it immediately before the hit, add 9 (2d8) piercing damage and apply Prone.
